summary: A multi-engine synthesizer and sequencer firmware with four instrument tracks and four extra MIDI tracks, chord and harmony keys, and songs built from patterns.
features: Engines: PROPHET, FM6 (6-operator, DX7 SysEx), CZ-1, SID and DRUM
64-step sequencer with chords, ties, slide, chance and motion recording
Songs of up to 64 sections with timed master punch effects
AUTO and AUTO2 chord keys, arpeggiator and 70 scales
USB MIDI and audio with optional four-stem recording, Bluetooth MIDI, USB Host
Web editor for every parameter, plus backup and restore
